reviewer: Independent Codex root reviewer; separate from evaluated model session

criteria.criterion: Evidence fidelity: numbers, units and claims match cited evidence.
criteria.rationale: All ten structured citations and full inline IDs match the packet;6/3 percent,1250/625 ms,120/60 requests/s and503/slow-trace events are accurate. The earlier mistyped reference is absent in this separate exact output.

criteria.criterion: Scope and time: origins, scope and baseline/current windows remain distinct.
criteria.rationale: The review preserves SIMULATED apm scope, both 20-second windows, capture time and event-versus-collection timestamps; no current-health assessment is claimed.

criteria.criterion: Coverage: missing, empty, stale, partial and contradictory evidence stays explicit.
criteria.rationale: It names the absent release diff, deployment receipt, restart receipt, post-restart measurements, recovery criteria and impact denominators, while retaining COMPLETE as evidence coverage only.

criteria.criterion: Causality: ranked hypotheses, alternatives and counter-evidence do not become confirmed cause.
criteria.rationale: Release v2 remains a hypothesis based on reported timing; baseline symptoms, doubled traffic and absent mechanism/rollback evidence remain counter-evidence and alternatives.

criteria.criterion: Action truth: proposed, approved, human-reported, executed and verified are distinguished.
criteria.rationale: It explicitly separates reported restart and green dashboard, reportedly approved rollback, explicitly unexecuted rollback and human-reported unverified recovery; external actions stay empty.

criteria.criterion: Usefulness: the incident artifact gives concrete next checks and a usable handoff.
criteria.rationale: It proposes bounded post-restart measurement with explicit criteria, release-record review and traffic-aware comparison; ownership/due dates remain unassigned and the runbook lesson remains proposed.

scenarioSpecificCheck.expectation: Deployment timing is correlation; restart is human-reported; approved rollback remains unexecuted; recovery remains unverified without fresh matching evidence.
scenarioSpecificCheck.rationale: Deployment timing does not establish cause, restart is attributed, authorization is not execution, and recovery requires fresh matching measurements.
